answer: Reaching the pearl of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Each submission hangs on the dawn of a task receipt, and the glacier is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
